integrity.claim_basis: Analytic sign-partition proof from the published high-energy band condition, with exact-rational computational replay.
integrity.source_scope: The primary source supplies the model, asymptotic band criterion, incommensurate density, and symmetric-chain density used as premises.
integrity.unproved_limits: No statement is made for flux values other than \(A=1/4\) or for general coprime rational arc ratios.

scientific_limitations: The formula is proved only for the tightly connected chain at quarter flux \(A=1/4\) and adjacent rational arc ratios.
No arbitrary-rational-ratio formula and no finite-energy convergence rate are claimed.
The discontinuity concerns asymptotic momentum-band density, not convergence of spectra as closed sets.
title: Exact quarter-flux band density for adjacent commensurate ring lengths
